specs.title: Offset Heavy Tee
specs.desc: 240 gsm cotton jersey oversized short-sleeve T-shirt; wide straight body, dropped shoulders, generous short sleeves, medium ribbed crewneck, straight double-stitched hem, tiny off-white offset two-horizontal-bar chest mark.

specs.title: Plane Box Tee
specs.desc: 260 gsm cotton jersey short-sleeve box tee; visibly shorter and squarer body than the reference tee, wide structured oversized sleeves, substantial clean ribbed crewneck, straight cropped hem. Plain exterior with no chest logo; small discreet SIDEFORM interior neck label only.

specs.title: Axis Long Sleeve
specs.desc: 220 gsm cotton jersey long-sleeve T-shirt; relaxed slightly longer body, dropped shoulder, full-length sleeves with narrow ribbed cuffs, ribbed crewneck, straight hem, tiny off-white offset two-horizontal-bar chest mark.

specs.title: Frame Long Sleeve
specs.desc: 240 gsm cotton jersey long-sleeve T-shirt; wide straight body, dropped shoulders, full-length sleeves, clean crewneck, subtle vertical panel seams running just inside the side seams and across the upper shoulder, straight hem. Plain exterior; no large graphics.

specs.title: Volume Pullover
specs.desc: 400 gsm heavyweight cotton-rich loopback pullover hoodie; oversized full-length wide body, large double-layer hood, long dropped sleeves with deep ribbed cuffs, large single kangaroo pocket, ribbed hem. No zipper, no drawstrings, plain exterior with a discreet SIDEFORM interior neck label.

specs.title: Structure Hoodie
specs.desc: 420 gsm dense cotton-rich fleece pullover hoodie; distinctly cropped square body, very broad dropped shoulders, sculptural double-layer hood, long voluminous sleeves ending in wide ribbed cuffs, wide ribbed hem, no front pocket and no drawstrings. Tiny off-white offset two-horizontal-bar chest mark.

specs.title: Contour Crew
specs.desc: 380 gsm cotton-rich loopback crewneck sweatshirt; relaxed wide torso, dropped shoulder, full-length sleeves, deep restrained ribbed crew neckline, cuffs and straight hem, no hood, no pockets, no exterior graphics. Discreet SIDEFORM interior neck label.

specs.title: Shell Utility Jacket
specs.desc: Lightweight matte cotton-nylon woven oversized utility jacket; broad angular panels, center black coil zipper, low stand collar, two symmetrical rectangular flap pockets at lower front, long dropped sleeves with simple elastic cuffs, straight hip-length hem, no hood, no shiny coating. Small discreet tonal offset-bar woven label at side seam.

specs.title: Transit Work Jacket
specs.desc: 320 gsm substantial cotton canvas work jacket; square boxy waist-to-hip-length body, pointed fold-down shirt collar, matte dark center snap-button placket, two large open-top square patch pockets at lower front, long sleeves with button cuffs, straight hem. No zipper, no hood. Small discreet tonal offset-bar woven label on pocket edge.

specs.title: Grid Cargo Pant
specs.desc: 260 gsm cotton twill cargo pants; full-length straight wide legs, loose hips and thighs, structured waistband with belt loops, matte center button and zipper fly, curved front hand pockets, one low-profile rectangular flap cargo pocket on the outer side of each thigh, plain hems, two flat welt rear pockets. No straps, no drawcords. Tiny tonal offset-bar woven side label.

specs.title: Drift Baggy Jean
specs.desc: 12 oz cotton denim baggy jeans; full-length extra-wide legs, relaxed seat, five-pocket construction, classic curved front pockets with coin pocket, belt loops, matte button and zip fly, two plain pentagonal back patch pockets, clean long hems. No tears, no distressing, no printed graphics. Tiny tonal offset-bar woven waistband label.

specs.title: Interval Utility Short
specs.desc: 240 gsm cotton twill utility shorts; knee-length wide leg openings, relaxed hip, structured waistband with belt loops, matte button and zip fly, front slash hand pockets, two compact low-profile outer-leg utility flap pockets, two flat rear welt pockets, straight hems. Tiny tonal offset-bar woven side label.
